summary: Explain how registers, shared storage and block size constrain resident work without turning occupancy into an objective by itself.
outcomes: Compute resource-limited block residency for a stated GPU.
Explain latency hiding, spilling and instruction-level parallelism tradeoffs.
sequence: Fill an SM with blocks subject to multiple resource budgets.
Connect resident warps to ready and stalled work.
Increase per-thread registers and expose residency steps.
Benchmark block-size and register tradeoffs with counter evidence.

visual.question: Which resource prevents another block from fitting?
visual.interaction: Adjust registers, block size and shared memory under a named hardware profile.

practice.task: Compare three launch configurations and reject an occupancy-only decision.
practice.success: Chosen configuration is justified by correctness, runtime and resource evidence.
